02a4df5f9777d66c5d1060a942e10e18684cf3f9.summary: Zscaler ThreatLabz analyses exploitation of CVE-2026-88771, a critical unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway that Citrix disclosed on 27 September 2026. Attackers poisoned appliance logs with a forged failure record that a privileged maintenance script later executed, then tried to deploy web shells and a FreeBSD implant. The report notes overlap with StyleSmuggler (CVE-2026-75650) infrastructure but says this does not establish threat actor attribution.

02e61990f3e053afd9e6aaa3b1a6fd466e46fbd3.summary: Breakglass Intelligence reports on a Kimsuky command-and-control server with directory listing enabled, serving a three-stage kill chain that starts from a CHM help file disguised as API documentation. The stages cover system reconnaissance with scheduled-task persistence, a PowerShell bridge, and a keylogger with clipboard monitoring and timed exfiltration. The report maps about 79 domains across five IPs on Korean and US VPS providers and free dynamic DNS services, including Naver and tax-themed phishing lures aimed at South Korean users. It attributes the activity to Kimsuky (DPRK) with…

02ddb0f91d9998840a475540ca2a07d9827e8613.summary: S2W analysis of BlackCat, a ransomware family written in Rust and published 10 Dec 2021. Its configuration fields match those of BlackMatter, but S2W found it difficult to conclude they are the same group. The report describes negotiation and leak sites, two victims posted on the leak site, and recruitment of pentesters and affiliates on underground forums. After public attention, the operator deleted the victim information and posted a warning.

02bbbc2164a63432960e2f7f94e2e26687377a73.summary: This is an ArchWiki help article about configuring system time on Linux. It covers hardware and system clocks, UTC versus local time, time zones, time skew, NTP and SNTP time synchronization, and troubleshooting clock problems. It describes no threat actor, malware, vulnerability, or security incident, so it is not a threat report.
